scope: Only phase 1: immutable project model, names, bounded declarative AST parser, diagnostics and documented local example; no phase 2
designNotes: GretlProject adds immutable defaultTargetSources metadata while retaining the proposed four-argument construction
Settings reuse CompilerSettings with scriptBaseClass cleared; no jobs or AST transformations are executed
Only Groovy internal empty-script ReturnStatement sentinel is accepted, never source return statements
Path checks cover root and included chains within the real root; not a general filesystem sandbox or atomic concurrent-filesystem transaction
Groovy module-import AST nodes have no position; Groovy lexer locates the rejected IMPORT token, solely for diagnostics without changing the AST allowlist
Quoted literal start maps Groovy codepoint columns to UTF-16 offsets; valid escaped line continuations preserved without expanding the AST allowlist
Literal quote forms use GroovyLangLexer tokens bounded by native AST ranges; parenthesized constants, Unicode and CR/LF/CRLF preserve parser coordinates; no manual column or line conversion

protocol.candidateIdentity: External post-commit handoff and independent report only
protocol.reviewScope: entire phaseBaseSha..candidateSha in a separate detached worktree; independent required tests; archive unchanged report in separate review-only commit

knownLimitations: Directory CLI, shared project registration/runtime and project JAR remain unimplemented and out of phase-1 scope
All 27 phase-2/3 PRJ cases explicitly unexecuted
No new full backing-service/GeoTools, IMAGE, Linux, Windows, Native, empty-cache or production qualification
Uses existing Maven cache and fixed current JDK25 patch
JaCoCo does not instrument forked product processes
Development red/first-targeted failures are preserved and explained in implementation report; mandatory gate has no failures or skips

reviewAttempts.finding: MAJOR M1: module import original source line missing
reviewAttempts.correction: Token-derived original position and exact regression including comments, strings, CRLF and no side effects; independent retest pending

reviewAttempts.finding: MAJOR M2: valid quoted literals rejected after supplementary codepoints or with escaped line continuation
reviewAttempts.correction: Codepoint source offset plus removal of one-line restriction, strict UTF-8/quote/line-ending regressions; independent retest pending

reviewAttempts.finding: MAJOR M3: valid settings after bare CR rejected by source line split inconsistent with Groovy coordinates
reviewAttempts.correction: Native lexer/AST source range matching, strict CR/LF/CRLF/comment/shebang/position and domain regressions; independent retest pending

supersededPostCommitRuns.reason: Input hash index captured shortly after pretest start, not before; report wording corrected; no product/test changes; no gate claimed for interrupted run

ownAdditionalFindings.correction: Native token lookup within AST range, regression plus unchanged hostile-form checks; independent review pending
